# Current cosmology reading order

Start with [the latest Heartcell owner update](HEARTCELL_OWNER_UPDATE_02.md): original-source priority is settled; primordial cycles are ages; the Choir clarification and chronology conflict are recorded; the commissioned Equation drafts, Research taint, proximity taint and exceptional Hunt/death rule are preserved.

Then read [the earlier eleven owner corrections](OWNER_RECONCILIATION_REVIEWED_01.md). Their historical source-preference ambiguity and undefined cycle meaning are qualified by the latest update. The underlying Heartcell builder remains unresolved. An exact Harmony-to-Choir mapping and a fully reconciled awakening chronology remain open.

Read [creation and origins](CREATION_ORIGINS_REVIEWED_01.md) and [gods and pantheons](GODS_PANTHEONS_REVIEWED_01.md) as earlier records subject to both owner updates. Mephistopheles is Cania only; the devouring-to-one correction and no-essence-tether correction remain current. The survivor's identity and Maladomini's replacement ruler are not supplied.

Original Cosmology, Matrix and surviving World manuscripts govern cosmological source reading, with explicit owner corrections applied. Original passages, mortal belief, owner decisions and new notebook designs retain separate provenance. The new Equation drafts do not recover the missing original formula or World I-VI.

This is Director/design material. The [Q6 endgame companion](Q6_LATER_LOCK_REVIEWED_01.md) is verified and applied: it distinguishes the registered crystal path and public ceiling from open identity and full encounter mechanics. The [planes reference](PLANES_REVIEWED_01.md) is now verified within its bounded scope. Souls/death/resurrection, history, divine/class powers and campaign revelations still need their remaining reviews. Numerical mechanics, runtime, human playtesting and publication are not certified by these records.

The [planes review](PLANES_REVIEWED_01.md) preserves the saved website, original account and mortal teaching with their different authority. Its corrected return passed 468 local checks, including 64 frozen source hashes and 18 actual travel-card bindings. The first return and all source records remain preserved. Operational soul/death jurisdiction now follows in the [submitted souls/Research conference](../../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/COSMOLOGY_SOULS_RESEARCH_01_SUBMISSION_RECEIPT.json). This covers the 12 SH and 9 ER discussion sections and 34 situations, with library and chronology context. GPT was responding at submission; no verdict or new numerical model is implied.

For the next souls/death conference, use the [concrete souls, forbidden research and Hunt draft](SOULS_DEATH_HUNT_CONFERENCE_DRAFT_01.md): 12 discussion sections and 20 situations, with 48 exact evidence locations verified. It has been submitted in the combined souls/Research conference; its new operating proposals remain unadopted. Its current status correction recognizes the reviewed standalone Soul Mirror procedure; the legacy pending catalog is historical evidence. No numerical taint scale or intervention route has been chosen.

For the Equation puzzle, use the [existing-library source inventory](EQUATION_LIBRARY_SOURCE_INVENTORY_01.md): 22 qualified records, 125 checked evidence locations, 6 conference questions and 8 review situations. Cantor’s Archive is mapped to Floor 47; the original Wax Library is a Dungeon chamber seed without a fixed floor. Other archive names are not automatically additional Descent libraries. No Equation fragment, new location, numeric progression or taint rule is adopted by the inventory.

The [Equation Research interface and Director worksheet](EQUATION_RESEARCH_INTERFACE_DRAFT_01.md) adds 9 discussion sections and 14 worked situations, with 61 exact evidence locations checked. The existing language review and its seven final artifact hashes remain intact. Research’s mapping to the 20-skill character system, personal high-rank qualifications and the threshold of functional Equation understanding remain explicit joint-review questions. Ordinary language, class, assistance and elapsed-work procedures are preserved.

The [chronology and research-site comparison](CHRONOLOGY_RESEARCH_SITES_DRAFT_01.md) preserves 16 relative events and all printed dates, qualifies 9 research sites, and carries 8 open questions with 8 discussion situations. Its 173 evidence locations are checked. Original epilogue portability does not automatically place the Wax Library in the starting era or adopt its rules. The current campaign epoch, Library placements and calendar reconciliation remain open. The existing 17 epilogue rule IDs are reused. Website findings are static-source observations, not a rendered publication test.

Historical workflow sentences inside the frozen draft artifacts describe their creation time. The owner has already created Part 3, planes verification is complete, and the combined souls/Research packet has been submitted. No continuation permission is pending. The draft source findings and open design decisions are preserved.
